info.name: SAP API Management API Portal API

description.content:
The SAP API Management API Portal API provides RESTful endpoints built on OData principles for programmatically managing API proxies, API products, applications, developers, policies, and key-value maps within the SAP API Management platform. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with credentials from the service key generated for the API Portal Access Plan. The base URL is tenant-specific: https://{tenant-url}/apiportal/api/1.0/Management.svc.
